## Clean data

```{R}
library("tidyverse")
```

### Rename columns

```{R}
cancer_data_c1 <- read_csv(file = "data/prostate_cancer.csv", 
                        show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  
# Columns are renamed for better description
  rename(
  patient_num = patno,
  estrogen_treatment = rx,
  follow_up_months = dtime, 
  weight = wt, 
  performance = pf, 
  heart_disease_history = hx,
  systolic_bp_10 = sbp,
  diastolic_bp_10 = dbp,
  baseline_electrocardiogram = ekg,
  serum_hemoglobin = hg,
  primary_tumor_size= sz, 
  stage_and_histological_grade = sg,
  prostatic_acid_phosphatase = ap,
  bone_mestastasis = bm,
  )
```

### Unpack status column

```{R}
cancer_data_c2 <- cancer_data_c1 |>
separate_wider_delim(
  status,
  delim = " - ",
  names = c("vital_status", "death_cause"),
  too_few = "align_start"
)
```

### Replace non-descriptive abbreviations

```{R}
cancer_data_c3 <- cancer_data_c2 |>
  mutate(
    death_cause = str_replace(death_cause, " ca$", " cancer"),
    baseline_electrocardiogram = case_match(
      baseline_electrocardiogram,
      "heart block or conduction def" ~ "heart block or conduction defect",
      "old MI" ~ "old myocardial infarction",
      "rhythmic disturb & electrolyte ch" ~ "rhythmic disturbance and electrolyte changes",
      .default = baseline_electrocardiogram
    )
  )
```
